This workshop shows how to make a Quarto website and put it online.
Replace this text with a short description of your own workshop.
Say who it is for and what the learners can do at the end.

## How the workshop works

The workshop has four modules.
This page is the first module.
Each other module is a section of the sidebar.
The bar above the page shows the module that you are in and a timer for the page.

The sidebar remembers the pages that you have read.
Start with the first module and follow the order of the sidebar.

## Before you start

You need a computer with a terminal and a web browser.
You do not need any other tool, because the first module installs them.
